description_en: Triggers a workflow to be executed multiple times
description_zh: 触发一个工作流多次执行
kebab_example: aliyun composer group-invoke-flow --flow-id lc-uf6axpwfcw4ubx --group-key 1632117849243 --data Items_:_resourceId_:_i-bp1383wskmaa65duviwh_,_regionId_:_cn-hangzhou_,_resourceType_:_ACS::ECS::Instance_,_Source_:_CloudConfig --client-token abcdefghijklmn --total-count 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GroupInvokeFlow

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow that you want to execute
parameters.name: flow_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the group. The name must be unique among the groups
parameters.help_zh: 本次批量执行的分组名，不同执行分组之间不能重复
parameters.name: group_key

parameters.help_en: The information required by the group execution. Set this parameter to a JSON array of strings in the following format:`{"Items": []}`. Each string provides the information required by one time of execution. The string must use the format of the Data parameter in the InvokeFlow operation
parameters.help_zh: 该分组执行所需的数据，为JSON字符串，格式为：`{"Items": []}`。Items数组每一项为单次执行的参数。单次执行参数的编写方式和InvokeFlow的Data参数一致
parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The number of times of execution. The value must be the same as the number of strings in the value of the Data parameter
parameters.help_zh: 该组执行包含的执行数，需要和Data.Items数组中的个数一致
parameters.name: total_count

parameters.help_en: The tag that is attached to each time of execution. The value is a JSON array. The number of tags in the array is the same as the value of the TotalCount parameter
parameters.help_zh: 为该分组下的每次执行打标签，格式为JSON数组，数组内为对应执行的标签对象。数组包含的标签对象个数需与TotalCount一致
parameters.name: tags

CurrentCount.description_en: The number of times of execution that are pending

GroupInvocationId.description_en: The unique identifier of the execution
GroupInvocationId.description_zh: 本次运行的唯一标识符

Status.description_en:
The status of the group. Valid values:

New: The group is created and waiting to be executed.
Started: The group is being executed.
Canceled: The group was canceled.
Failed: The execution failed.
Completed: All the times of execution in the group are complete.
Unknown: The group status is uncertain. In this case, a system error may occur.
TimedOut: The execution timed out.
Paused: The execution was suspended
Status.description_zh:
本次分组执行的状态：
New：请求已经创建，待运行
Started：已经开始运行
Canceled：已经取消
Failed：执行失败
Completed：分组内所有执行已经完成
Unknown：执行状态不确定，常见于系统错误
TimedOut：执行超时
Paused：执行被暂停

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful.

true: The workflow execution is triggered.
false: The workflow execution failed to be triggered.

: You can call the GetInvocationLog operation to check whether the workflow execution is successful
Success.description_zh:
是否运行成功。

true：工作流已经被触发
false：触发失败

如果需要查询工作流运行结果，请使用GetInvocationLog查询运行结果
